global:
  output_dir: /data
  default_fps: 15.0
  motion_threshold: 1500
  blur_size: 7
  cooldown_secs: 10.0
  dilate_iters: 2
  clip_duration: 5.0
  pre_buffer_secs: 5.0
  max_videos: 100
  stale_days: 30

cameras:
  - name: webcam
    url: http://192.168.1.121:1984/api/stream.mjpeg?src=webcam
    motion_threshold: 30

securityContext:
  fsGroup: 1000
  runAsUser: 1000
  runAsGroup: 1000
  runAsNonRoot: true

set -eux

if [ -z "$(ls -A ${OBSIDIAN_PATH})" ]; then
  echo "[INFO] Directory is empty. Cloning repository..."
  git clone https://${GIT_USER}:${GIT_TOKEN}@${GIT_URL} ${OBSIDIAN_PATH}
  echo "[INFO] Clone completed."
else
  echo "[WARN] Directory not empty. Skipping clone."
fi

cd ${OBSIDIAN_PATH}
while true; do
  echo "[INFO] Pulling changes from remote repository..."
  git pull
  echo "[INFO] Pull completed. Sleeping for ${PULL_INTERVAL} seconds..."
  sleep ${PULL_INTERVAL}
done

log:
  level: debug
cache:
  enabled: true
container:
  require_docker: true
  docker_timeout: 300s
runner:
  labels:
    - "ubuntu-latest:docker://docker-registry.hankeln.work/gitea-runner:1.2.0"
    - "ubuntu-22.04:docker://docker-registry.hankeln.work/gitea-runner:1.2.0"
    - "ubuntu-20.04:docker://docker-registry.hankeln.work/gitea-runner:1.2.0"

You are a coding agent running in a Kubernetes cluster. Be terse — no explanations, no commentary. Fetch tasks from the MCP API. For each task: use your built-in tools to investigate the relevant code, then output a concise bullet-point plan. Nothing else.

[global]
server_name = "eno1.dev"
address = ["::"]
port = 8008

log = "info"

database_path = "/data"
database_backup_path = "/backups"
database_backups_to_keep = 1

rocksdb_compression_algo = "zstd"
rocksdb_compression_level = 32767
rocksdb_bottommost_compression_level = 32767
rocksdb_bottommost_compression = true

max_request_size = 20971520

query_over_tcp_only = true
ip_lookup_strategy = 3

allow_registration = true
registration_token_file = "/config/token"
new_user_displayname_suffix = ""

allow_federation = true

# Additional config
[global.well_known]
client = "https://m.eno1.dev"
server = "m.eno1.dev:443"
